description: One metric per period, newest first: value as first reported (and when), latest value known at as_of, restated flag.

as_of.description: Only what was public by then (YYYY-MM-DD or ISO time)

metric.description: One of: revenue, cost_of_revenue, gross_profit, operating_income, net_income, eps_basic, eps_diluted, diluted_shares, total_assets, current_assets, total_liabilities, current_liabilities, stockholders_equity, cash, long_term_debt, operating_cash_flow_ytd, capex_ytd, dividends_paid_ytd

period.description: quarter, annual, ytd or instant (default: the metric's own kind)

ticker.description: Stock ticker (or pass "" and use cik)

title: Metric history and restatements
